Name: NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC-1:2018)
Description: The Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC-1:2018) were developed by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) across 5 Main Domains and 29 Subdomains (114 controls) for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

Requirements.Name: 1-1 Cybersecurity Strategy
Requirements.Description: Define and approve cybersecurity strategy and governance goals for the OCI tenancy.

Requirements.Name: 1-2 Cybersecurity Management & Compartments
Requirements.Description: Ensure tenancy administration is segregated and restricted to authorized security administrators.

Requirements.Name: 1-3 Cybersecurity Policies and Procedures
Requirements.Description: Establish, document, and enforce IAM security policies across all OCI compartments.

Requirements.Name: 1-4 Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities
Requirements.Description: Define roles and privileges without conflict of interest across OCI groups and compartments.

Requirements.Name: 1-5 Cybersecurity Risk Management
Requirements.Description: Enable continuous threat and posture detection using Oracle Cloud Guard.

Requirements.Name: 1-6 Cybersecurity in Project Management
Requirements.Description: Enforce baseline secure configuration and hardening prior to launching cloud resources.

Attributes.SubSection: 1-6 Cybersecurity in Information and Technology Project Management

Requirements.Name: 1-7 Compliance with Laws, Standards, and Regulations
Requirements.Description: Ensure continuous compliance of OCI resources with national cybersecurity regulations.

Attributes.SubSection: 1-7 Compliance with Cybersecurity Standards, Laws and Regulations

Requirements.Name: 1-8 Periodical Cybersecurity Review and Audit
Requirements.Description: Maintain and review comprehensive audit logs across all OCI compartments.

Requirements.Name: 1-9 Cybersecurity in Human Resources
Requirements.Description: Enforce security controls on personnel accessing privileged OCI console roles.

Requirements.Name: 1-10 Cybersecurity Awareness and Training
Requirements.Description: Enforce strong authentication culture and security hygiene among cloud users.

Requirements.Name: 2-1 Asset Management
Requirements.Description: Maintain an updated inventory of all compute, database, storage, and networking assets.

Requirements.Name: 2-2 Identity and Access Management
Requirements.Description: Mandate MFA for console access, 14-character passwords, and 90-day key rotations.

Requirements.Name: 2-3 Information System & Processing Protection
Requirements.Description: Harden compute instances, isolate processing environments, and disable legacy endpoints.

Attributes.SubSection: 2-3 Information Systems and Information Processing Facilities Protection

Requirements.Name: 2-4 Email Protection
Requirements.Description: Enforce secure email and communication channels with strict access validation.

Requirements.Name: 2-5 Networks Security Management
Requirements.Description: Restrict internet exposure on management ports (SSH 22, RDP 3389) across all NSGs and VCN security lists.

Requirements.Name: 2-6 Mobile Devices Security
Requirements.Description: Enforce strong authentication and credential rotation for mobile and remote access to OCI.

Requirements.Name: 2-7 Data and Information Protection
Requirements.Description: Prohibit public access on object storage buckets and emit audit events for bucket access.

Requirements.Name: 2-8 Cryptography
Requirements.Description: Encrypt block volumes, boot volumes, and object buckets with customer-managed keys (CMK) and key rotation.

Requirements.Name: 2-9 Backup and Recovery Management
Requirements.Description: Ensure automated backup schedules and recovery capabilities for OCI block and boot volumes.

Requirements.Name: 2-10 Vulnerabilities Management
Requirements.Description: Continuously detect vulnerabilities and security problems using Cloud Guard detectors.

Requirements.Name: 2-11 Penetration Testing
Requirements.Description: Assess internet-facing VCNs and public endpoints through regular penetration testing.

Requirements.Name: 2-12 Cybersecurity Event Logs & 365-Day Retention
Requirements.Description: Retain audit logs for at least 365 days and enable event notification rules.

Attributes.SubSection: 2-12 Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management

Requirements.Name: 2-13 Cybersecurity Incident and Threat Management
Requirements.Description: Monitor and respond to tenancy security events via Cloud Guard rules.

Requirements.Name: 2-14 Physical Security
Requirements.Description: Enforce physical and logical boundaries for cloud infrastructure access.

Requirements.Name: 2-15 Web Application Security
Requirements.Description: Protect external databases, analytics instances, and web services from public exposure.

Requirements.Name: 3-1 Business Continuity Management (BCM)
Requirements.Description: Ensure disaster recovery and backup resilience for block storage and critical workloads.

Requirements.Name: 4-1 Third-Party Cybersecurity
Requirements.Description: Manage third-party token lifecycle and restrict API permissions.

Requirements.Name: 4-2 Cloud Computing and Hosting Cybersecurity
Requirements.Description: Enforce storage encryption, private bucket policies, and workload isolation.
